fileMetadata.title: File Metadata
fileMetadata.description: Metadata for a temporarily stored file with expiration and access parameters

originalName.description: Original file name uploaded by user

size.description: Size of the file in bytes

uploadTimestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when uploaded

expiresAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when file expires

downloadCount.description: Number of times file has been downloaded

maxDownloads.description: Maximum allowed downloads before deletion (0 for unlimited)

isBurnAfterReading.description: Whether file should be deleted immediately after 1 download

passwordHash.description: Optional SHA-256 hash of password if protected

deleteToken.description: Secret token to permit uploader to delete the file early

batchId.description: ID of parent batch upload if uploaded as part of multiple files

isExpired.description: Flag marking file as expired and pending cleanup

storagePath.description: Relative storage path on server disk or storage

batchMetadata.title: Batch Manifest
batchMetadata.description: Metadata for a batch collection of files uploaded simultaneously

id.description: Unique identifier for the file batch

totalFiles.description: Total number of files in this batch

totalSize.description: Combined byte size of files in this batch

/files/{fileId}.description: Contains metadata and access controls for individual uploaded temporary files

/batches/{batchId}.description: Contains manifests for multi-file bundle drops
